body: Back to draft: review at e1fc569 requests two pinning tests (mode switching across sections, Tormach inch G96). See the review above.

review fixes at ed514853 (merge of upstream/main v0.18.0 at 048e8e51, clean): pinned the G96/G97 mode switching across sections - a lower tool clamp posts `G50 S3000`, `G96 S170`, then `G50 S12000` before `G97` on fanuc-lathe and `G96 D3000 ...` then `G97` on tormach-lathe (`a_lower_tool_clamp_is_lifted_back_to_the_machines_before_a_later_g97`); a tool max over the machine's posts the machine's clamp (`a_tool_clamp_over_the_machines_posts_the_machines`); the inch Tormach path posts `G96 D3000 S558` (170 m/min / 0.3048, D in rpm) (`an_inch_tormach_posts_vc_in_ft_per_min_and_d_in_rpm`); and the non-blocking note - with no machine max the tool's G50 carries into a later G97, now commented in fanuc-lathe.cps, pinned by `with_no_machine_max_the_tools_g50_carries_into_a_later_g97` and recorded in docs/decisions/891-lathe-cutting-data.md · quick gate green (`cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`, 5 steps, 0 failed; by hand lathe_post_css 10, lathe_post 7, lathe_post_refusals 6, lathe_post_g76 8, lathe_post_tormach 7, posting 17, golden_cl 25, all passed) · no goldens or snapshot PNGs changed · ready for a re-review

<!-- pr-reviewer: ed514853fae37081476917a1a7b252fcd6832724 -->
**Needs changes before merge.** One G-code safety gap: a G96 is left in force into a later live-tool section.

This PR changes posted lathe spindle words, so it got the high-tier review: an independent trial merge with current `main`, a build, and attempts to break the posts. Earlier `pr-reviewer` comments on this PR came from the contributor's own agents. This review is separate from them.

### What looks good
- **G96 always has a clamp.** Both posts take min(machine max, tool max rpm). Fanuc writes `G50 S` before `G96` when that clamp is not already in force. Tormach writes `G96 D<cap>`. With neither clamp stated, both refuse by name (`a_g96_with_no_clamp_anywhere_is_refused_by_name`). A zero, negative, NaN or out-of-range `max_rpm` fails `TurningData::is_sane`. `ChangeTool`/`AddTool` refuse such a tool, and `post::dump` never writes a non-finite PARAM.
- **G97 comes back when the next turning or drilling section needs it.** Threading never runs CSS (`css_op` excludes it). A G97 section after a G96 section writes `G97 S.. M03`, and Fanuc lifts a lower tool clamp back to the machine's.
- **Units are consistent.** The Fanuc lathe post is G21 only, so S is in m/min. Tormach converts to ft/min under G20. The per-rev F is feed/rpm at the applied rpm, so `F0.2` is the table's f/rev.
- **Goldens.** The only golden change is the new `fanuc-lathe/facing_css.nc`. I diffed it line by line against `facing.nc`: only the tool note, `G96 S170` for `G97 S3000`, and the F words differ (`F0.2` cut, `F0.1` plunge). No existing golden moved, and no snapshot PNG changed.
- **Table and file format.** The table has a provenance comment. Its values are plausible, on the conservative side of handbook ranges, and contain no vendor or HSMWorks material. The `turning` key is additive and `skip_serializing_if`, so old files load unchanged.
- **Commands.** `ApplyCuttingData` stays one undo unit. The MCP gap is named (#732).

### Requested before merge
1. **A live-tool section after a G96 section is posted under modal G96** (`assets/posts/fanuc-lathe.cps`, the live branch of `startPreamble` that writes `G98` / `cAxisOn` / `spindleOn S`, about lines 484-486).
   - On `main` the app never put `SurfaceSpeed` on the stream. This PR makes G96 reachable in real programs, and the live branch never states `G97`.
   - I fed a hand-built stream through the post: a CSS turning section, then a `LiveTool` section at 3000 rpm on a mill-turn. Output:
     ```
     G50 S6000
     G96 S200 M03
     ...
     M05
     (T0202 EM)
     T0202
     G98
     M1001
     M1003 S3000
     ```
   - With G96 still modal, a control can read `S3000` as a surface speed, not the live spindle's rpm.
   - Fix: write `G97` before the live spindle-on, or in `endPreamble` after any section that posted a G96.
   - Pin it with a twin of `a_section_without_surface_speed_posts_g97_after_one_with_it` that uses a `LiveTool` section.

### Questions / notes (not blocking)
- `cutting_turn::css_of` filters out an insane `TurningData` and posts G97 instead. That is safe, and commands refuse such a tool anyway. I did not check whether the project loader runs `Tool::is_sane` on a hand-edited `turning` key.
- The tool editor's Vc field allows up to 6000 in m/min, but `MAX_VC` is 2000. Apply then refuses. Capping the field range in metric would be friendlier.
- Files already over 400 lines grow a little: `tools.rs` 714, `post/mod.rs` 641, `posting.rs` 1226, `project/file.rs` 522, `ui/state.rs`.
- Not exercised here: the GUI rows, the inch display lens, and grooving/form/boring end-to-end posts. The PR body says so too.
- #1058 is stacked on this PR, so this one merges first. Both are `feat` and merge at the cut.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
